paragraphs: equivant sells software for the justice process, listed on its home page as court, pretrial, treatment court, admin law, drug testing LIS, supervision, and corrections. The court solution is described as a way to simplify case management and improve access to justice, and the pretrial solution as a way to expedite release decisions, reduce FTAs, and track key data points. Other listed solutions manage drug testing programs and deliver timely results, and optimize classification and custody management for corrections.

The home page lists the organizations served as courts, administrative courts and commissions, tribunals, dispute resolution agencies, corrections, supervision, pretrial, drug testing, and treatment court. A team page says three software companies serving the justice industry together provide products and services for courts, probation and parole agencies, jails and prisons, pretrial agencies, drug and treatment courts, drug testing labs, and public attorneys. The about page reports more than 350+ justice agency customers internationally, supported over a span of four decades.

equivant describes itself as a portfolio of solutions built through both organic development and acquisitions, bringing together technology businesses focused on the justice community. The about page names Constellation Software as the parent company.

quote.text: equivant serves the justice industry with solutions that boost efficiency, streamline processes, and improve communication in justice agencies.
